hypotheses.persona: A single working professional with a standard Monday-to-Friday office schedule, who eats breakfast at home, commutes with transit, and returns in the evening to have dinner and relax.
hypotheses.rationale: The morning routine (phone, bowl, coffee mug at counter/table, then all work items leaving at 08:32-08:34) and evening return (keys, laptop, phone, transit card, travel mug, work lanyard) are nearly identical on Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday. The evening dinner and cleanup (plate, fork) and relaxation (phone, remote on sofa) also repeat. The consistent timing and items strongly support a standard office worker.

hypotheses.persona: A remote worker who occasionally goes to the office, but the evidence is weaker.
hypotheses.rationale: The laptop returns to a desk at 18:03 on Wednesday, which could be a home office, but the work lanyard and transit card suggest commuting. The morning departure of all work items is more consistent with an office worker. The pattern is too regular to suggest occasional remote work.
